The Separatist invasion has done little to stop the bazaars from operating, although the populace does seem a bit subdued. The signs of Confederacy presence can be felt everywhere. Tirahnn is a planet that thrives on commerce. It is a major hub on the Perlemian Trade Route and is at the center of the Zeemacht Cluster.
The various towns and cities on Tirahnn are famous for their large bazaars, where nearly any item imaginable can be bought- for the right price.
Tirahnn's wealthy live in towering skyscrapers, rarely descending to areas that they see as "below their station," and many claim to have not set foot on the ground in decades.
